verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen competed on Season 6 of The Voice in 2014.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wallen was on The Voice during Season 6, which aired in the spring of 2014." (R2,R3,R4); "In 2014, he competed in the sixth season of The Voice." (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state he competed in Season 6 in 2014.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen made it to the Playoffs on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wallen made it to the Playoffs on The Voice" (R2,R3,R4); "eliminated during the Playoffs portion" (R5); "eliminated during the playoffs" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly confirm he reached the Playoffs.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen was eliminated in the Playoffs round on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wallen sang “Stay” by Black Stone Cherry, and Levine eliminated him." in Playoffs (R2,R3,R4); "eliminated during the Playoffs" (R5,R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of elimination in Playoffs across sources.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen was eliminated before the live shows on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "made it to the Playoffs on The Voice, but was eliminated before the Live Shows." (R2,R3,R4); playoffs before live shows (R6)

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen was originally on Team Usher on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wallen selected Usher as his coach." (R2,R3,R4); "first being on Usher's team" (R5); "joined Usher's team" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently stated he originally joined Team Usher.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen was stolen by Team Adam Levine on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Levine used his Steal to keep Wallen" (R2,R3,R4); "Adam Levine stole him" (R5); "later taken by Adam Levine's team after his second round" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm steal by Adam Levine.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen was a 20-year-old Tennessee native during Season 6 of The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Born May 13, 1993 in Sneedville, Tennessee; competed in season 6 (spring 2014) (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Birthdate and location directly support age (20 at season start) and native status; precise calculation aligns.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen sang "Collide" by Howie Day during his audition on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "sang “Collide” by Howie Day" Blind Audition (R2,R3,R4); "auditioned with the song "Collide" by Howie Day" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Exact song and context directly matched.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen chose Usher as his coach on The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Wallen selected Usher as his coach." (R2,R3,R4); "Judges Shakira and Usher... Wallen joined Usher's team." (R6)

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen later noted that his elimination came after he finally sang a country song.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "I made it to the Top 20, and I finally sang a country song, and that’s when I got kicked off. Singing a country song." (R2,R3,R4)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from Wallen matches claim precisely.

verifications.claim: Sergio Sanchez of Atom Smash worked with Morgan Wallen immediately after his exit from The Voice.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "While in California to appear on The Voice, Wallen began working with Sergio Sanchez of Atom Smash, a vocal coach on the program."
verifications.reasoning: Working began during the show appearance, not after exit; timing contradicts 'immediately after'.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen did not win The Voice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Eliminated in playoffs (all); "I’m thankful that I didn’t win" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm early elimination, no win.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen has credited The Voice with kick-starting his career.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "That whole experience kind of kick-started me a little bit." (R5); "The Voice was instrumental in raising Wallen's profile" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote and statement crediting the show.

verifications.claim: Morgan Wallen has credited The Voice with helping him find his artistic identity.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "I’m thankful that I didn’t win because it gave me a chance to take a couple years after that show and really figure out who I was as an artist" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Credits post-show time after elimination, not the show itself; implies show did not help with identity.
